title: EMM information procedure in the UE

entities.name: EMM information procedure in the UE
entities.description: Procedure executed by the UE when receiving an EMM INFORMATION message. The UE accepts the message and optionally uses its contents to update stored information.

entities.name: EMM INFORMATION
entities.description: Message sent to the UE containing information that may be used to update stored UE information.

entities.name: EMM STATUS
entities.description: Message returned by the UE when it does not support the received EMM INFORMATION message, indicating the message type is not implemented.

entities.name: UE supports EMM INFORMATION message
entities.description: Condition indicating whether the UE has implemented support for the EMM INFORMATION message.

entities.name: Update UE stored information
entities.description: Optional behavior where the UE uses the contents of the EMM INFORMATION message to update appropriate information stored within the UE.

entities.name: EMM cause #97
entities.description: EMM cause value indicating 'message type non-existent or not implemented'.

relations.description: The EMM information procedure in the UE is triggered by receiving an EMM INFORMATION message.
The procedure behavior is guarded by whether the UE supports the EMM INFORMATION message.
If the UE supports the EMM INFORMATION message, it optionally updates stored information.
If the UE does not support the EMM INFORMATION message, it returns an EMM STATUS message.
The EMM STATUS message contains EMM cause #97 when the message type is not implemented.
